summary: VAR(6) model analysis of NH+SH coupled system for H004: NH→SH coupling is consistently stronger than SH→NH at ALL lag orders (VAR(6): NH→SH=0.705, SH→NH=0.374, asymmetry=-0.33). This direction is consistent across 2000-2012 and 2013-2025 subsets. KEY RESULT: H004 P004 CONFIRMED — simulating the fitted VAR model produces a global correlation dimension of 1.754±0.037, close to the observed 1.86 (A004). The simple 2-variable coupled system reproduces the low-dimensional dynamics. Note: The NH→SH direction in VAR is consistent with Granger causality (NH→SH at lag=1) but apparently contradicts TE (which found SH→NH dominant at 3-6 months). The resolution: TE measures non-linear information flow at specific lags, while VAR/Granger measure linear prediction skill — at ENSO timescales (wavelet: SH leads by 4 months), SH is the driver; at monthly timescales, NH is stronger. Temporal split reveals 2000-2012 R²=0.05 vs 2013-2025 R²=0.43, suggesting stronger coupling or more predictable dynamics in the post-2012 period.
